notes: Prompts are English on purpose: image models parse visual description more accurately.
Every prompt must stay <= 500 characters (AutoFlow POST /api/jobs limit).
No humans appear in this story, so the catalog hijab / Arab-features clauses do not apply.

Hard content rules from the story file, enforced inline in every prompt: nest visible on every page, mother present from page 1, no full darkness, no visible teeth, bird never afraid, 2 characters only, 2-3 elements per page, no burnt-in text.
page-001 is generated FIRST and alone, then reused as a character reference for the other 10 assets so the bird stays consistent.
style_tail: Soft preschool storybook art, rounded shapes, 3 elements max, calm warm light, deep navy sky with cyan and star-yellow accents, full-bleed to all four edges, no text, no logo, no frame, no border, no visible teeth, no fear.
model_note: imagen4 jobs are silently dropped by the queue on this account (confirmed by two live tests: job vanished, never reached processing/failed). nano_banana2 with quality:1K completed in ~50s and produced correct output (verified on page-001). All Flow assets below use nano_banana2.

assets.ratio_note: Flow models expose landscape/portrait/square only, so a native 3:4 canvas requires freepik. The catalog frame rule forbids reaching a ratio by cropping or padding afterwards, so the model is switched instead of the ratio. Note this routes to a different Chrome extension (Genova Images), which must also be connected.
